about:
Crossroads Solar operates from South Bend, Indiana, where it was founded on the principle of maximizing three core values with a unique twist. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named in public materials. Its facility at 1901 North Bendix Drive sits near the Indiana Toll Road, linking the operation to Chicago, Detroit, and broader Midwest logistics networks.

The company manufactures monocrystalline solar panels in 60-cell and 72-cell configurations, and provides product testing and certification services. Its panels carry a 10-year product warranty. Details on facility size, headcount, or production volumes are not publicly available.

Crossroads Solar serves the solar energy market, supplying panels for residential, commercial, and utility-scale installations. The company emphasizes sourcing from local industries where possible and offers national shipping via freight forwarders as well as local pickup from its South Bend facility.

The business was started on the idea that a company can balance three priorities—referred to as the three P's—though the specific priorities are not elaborated in available sources.
